nodes.label: Explicit authentication schemes (OpenIdConnect, Bearer, DataPlane)
nodes.rationale: Do not rely on a default scheme to satisfy policies; attach schemes on endpoint groups.

nodes.label: API client JWT bearer authentication (3.3)
nodes.rationale: Schemes explicit on endpoint groups; avoid permissive default scheme letting one credential satisfy another's policy.

nodes.label: Browser authentication: OIDC + encrypted cookie (3.2)
nodes.rationale: Cookie auth is ambient so every cookie mutation needs an antiforgery token; no wildcard CORS since dashboard is same-origin.

nodes.label: Data-plane authentication (3.4)
nodes.rationale: Per-service credential, not one shared secret; service reads only its own directive; hashed per-service key acceptable locally.

nodes.label: Step 4 - Data-plane credential separation
nodes.rationale: Plain SHA-256 is enough because keys are 32 random bytes; Phase 3 can swap to Entra workload identity without changing the route.

nodes.label: Authorization test matrix
nodes.rationale: Cross-credential cells are 401 not 403 because each route checks only its own credential type.

nodes.label: Persistence and Lifecycle
nodes.rationale: Reads enforce active-and-unexpired rule so expired faults stop immediately even before cleanup runs.

nodes.label: Partial Unique Constraint
nodes.rationale: Prevents two active experiments per target even under concurrent requests.

nodes.label: Data-plane keys (X-Stria-Service-Key)
nodes.rationale: Stria stores only SHA-256 of each key and compares in constant time; each route checks only its own credential type so cross-credential use yields 401.

nodes.label: Component cohesion and coupling (REP, CCP, CRP, ADP, SDP, SAP)

nodes.label: Trusted audit identity (3.5)
nodes.rationale: Prefer Entra oid claim, fall back to sub/NameIdentifier; system actors system:expiry and system:kill-switch.

nodes.label: TriggeredBy derived from validated Entra claims
nodes.norm_label: triggeredby derived from validated entra claims

nodes.label: Defence in Depth Safety Model
nodes.rationale: Validation at domain, orchestrator, DB constraint, lease expiry and unfaulted health paths so no single check is relied on.

nodes.label: Phase 1 Safety Claim
nodes.rationale: A target never receives an out-of-bounds directive and never has two active experiments.

nodes.label: Step 0 - CI and quality gates
nodes.rationale: Lock files deferred because SDK implicit packages change between SDK patches, making locked restore brittle.

nodes.label: Review: do not trust self-report
nodes.rationale: Re-run gates and read the diff; orchestrator commits because Codex sandbox cannot reliably write .git.

nodes.label: 5-Phase Deployment Process
nodes.rationale: Prepare, Backup, Deploy, Verify, Confirm-or-Rollback; cannot roll back without backup.

nodes.label: Rollback Principles
nodes.rationale: Speed over perfection: roll back first, debug later; one rollback, not multiple changes.

nodes.label: Step 5 kill switch design
nodes.rationale: Append-only KillSwitchEvents table (current = latest event) fits audit needs better than a mutable row; enforce in DatabaseChaosOrchestrator.InjectFaultAsync in same transaction as write.

nodes.label: Global kill switch (3.7)
nodes.rationale: Orchestrator must check the kill switch before writing an experiment, not only in the HTTP handler; state changes are auditable.

nodes.rationale: Milestones 1-3 plus Latency/HttpFailure of Milestone 5 then Milestone 7 is the smallest coherent deployable release.

nodes.label: Identity provider and roles (3.1)
nodes.rationale: Three app roles rather than overloading ChaosOperator for administration; never authorize on display name or email.

nodes.label: Expand-contract pattern
nodes.rationale: Expand without default so historical rows remain visibly unprocessed; apply NOT NULL only after validation.

nodes.label: Test auth can hide real auth bugs
nodes.norm_label: test auth can hide real auth bugs
nodes.rationale: Microsoft.Identity.Web swaps the OIDC token handler so MapInboundClaims=false never reached it; ClaimMappingTests now cover real handlers.

nodes.label: MapInboundClaims lesson (Identity.Web replaces OIDC token handler)
nodes.norm_label: mapinboundclaims lesson (identity.web replaces oidc token handler)
nodes.rationale: Test cookie handler hid that the roles claim was renamed in production, denying every browser user.

nodes.label: Data-Plane Behavior
nodes.rationale: Monotonic TimeProvider local lease prevents clock skew from extending a fault.

nodes.label: Automatic Lease Expiry
nodes.rationale: Control-plane outage cannot extend a fault because both sides treat expired directives as inactive.

nodes.label: OIDC Keyless Cloud Authentication
nodes.rationale: Never store long-lived cloud credentials; short-lived OIDC tokens expire automatically.

nodes.label: timeout-minutes on Every Job
nodes.rationale: Prevents runaway or hanging jobs.

nodes.label: Least Privilege Permissions
nodes.rationale: Restrict workflow-level permissions to contents: read and expand only per job as needed.

nodes.label: pull_request_target Restriction
nodes.rationale: Label/association gates alone do not prevent untrusted execution; privileged jobs must not run PR-controlled code.

nodes.label: Script Injection Prevention
nodes.rationale: Untrusted ${{ }} values must pass via env vars, never directly in run: blocks.

nodes.label: Pin Actions to Full Commit SHA
nodes.norm_label: pin actions to full commit sha
nodes.rationale: Tags can be mutated or hijacked; full SHA prevents tag movement but is not a safety certification.

nodes.label: Secret Redaction Rules
nodes.rationale: Never print secret values even partially; report path, line, key name, type, redacted hint.
